values.title: The first-instance judgment has been served.
values.body: The Pudong Court has served the first-instance judgment, which found that the two food products involved failed to meet food safety standards and ruled on the refund, punitive damages, medical expenses, and litigation costs.

values.subject: Electronic service of the judgment: (2026) Hu0115MinChu18426No.
values.from_addr: Electronic Service of the Shanghai Pudong New Area People's Court <service@pudongcourt.gov.cn>
values.body_text: This court is serving you electronically with the first-instance judgment. The judgment makes findings regarding the Chinese label on the milk powder involved in the case, the ingredients of the substitute tea, the refund, punitive damages, medical expenses, and the case acceptance fee. The last page of the judgment states the appellate court and the period for filing an appeal. Please check and receive the complete document.

values.content_json: Service of judgment: The first-instance judgment has been received. The court ruled on the Chinese labeling of the milk powder, the ingredients of the tea substitute, the refund, punitive damages, medical-treatment losses, and the case acceptance fee; the complete orders and appeal rights are governed by the served document.
